title: Status
description: The status object (simulation.md §4.1). `sim.py status --game N` prints it merged with {"ok": true}; `plan`/`react`/`resolve` embed it, unwrapped, as their "status" field.

ok.description: Present only on the standalone `status` command's top-level output.

seat.description: phase 'plan': the active player. phase 'react'/'resolve': the transaction's actor.

continuing.description: phase 'plan' only: true when this is a replan continuation, not a fresh turn (skip recovery/discard_to_limit prompts).

pending_id.description: phase 'react'/'resolve' only: the open transaction's id.

reactors.description: phase 'react'/'resolve' only: seats still expected to answer (empty once phase flips to resolve).
